entries.title: Luke 11:1
segments: It happened he was praying in a certain place, and when he stopped, one of his disciples said to him, "Master, teach us how to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

entries.title: Luke 11:2
segments: So he said to them: "When you pray, say, "Father, hallowed be thy name; May thy kingdom come,

entries.title: Luke 11:3
segments: "Give us day by day our bread for the coming day;

entries.title: Luke 11:4
segments: "Forgive us our sins; for we also forgive everyone who has offended us; "And bring us not into temptation."

entries.title: Luke 11:5
segments: He also said to them: "Suppose you have a friend and you go to him, `My friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

entries.title: Luke 11:6
segments: "for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.'

entries.title: Luke 11:7
segments: "and he from indoors shall answer: `Do not pester me. The door is now closed, and my children are with me in bed. I cannot rise and give to you.'

entries.title: Luke 11:8
segments: "I tell you that, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunate persistence he will rise and give him whatever he needs.

entries.title: Luke 11:9
segments: "So I say to you: "Ask, and it shall be given to you; seek, and ye shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

entries.title: Luke 11:10
segments: "For he that asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks the door shall be opened.

entries.title: Luke 11:11
segments: "What father is there among you who, if his son asks for a loaf, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish will give him instead a serpent?

entries.title: Luke 11:12
segments: "Or if he asks for an egg, will offer him a scorpion?

entries.title: Luke 11:13
segments: "If you give good gifts to your children, how much more shall the Father who is in heaven give the Holy spirit to those that ask him!"

entries.title: Luke 11:14
segments: Once he was casting out a dumb demon, and when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spoke, and the people wondered.

entries.title: Luke 11:15
segments: But some of them said, "It is by Beelzebub, the prince of demons, that he cast out demons."

entries.title: Luke 11:16
segments: Others, tempting him, kept seeking from him a sign from heaven.

entries.title: Luke 11:17
segments: He knew their intentions and said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste and house falls upon house.

entries.title: Luke 11:18
segments: "And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?

entries.title: Luke 11:19
segments: "Do you say that I am casting out demons by the power of Beelzebub? If I then am casting out demons by Beelzebub, by whom are your sons casting them out? They therefore shall be your judges.

entries.title: Luke 11:20
segments: "But if it is by the finger of God that I am casting out demons, then the kingdom of God is come upon you.

entries.title: Luke 11:21
segments: "When the strong man fully aroused keeps guard over his homestead, his property is undisturbed;

entries.title: Luke 11:22
segments: "but when the stronger man attacks him, he takes away from the strong armor in which he was trusting and divides up the spoil.

entries.title: Luke 11:23
segments: "He who is not for me is against me, and he who is not gathering with me is scattering.

entries.title: Luke 11:24
segments: "Whenever a foul spirit is gone out of a man, it roams through waterless places, in search of rest; but when it can find none, it says, `I will go back to the house which I have left.'

entries.title: Luke 11:25
segments: When it comes and finds the house completely swept and garnished.

entries.title: Luke 11:26
segments: "Then it goes off and fetches seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the last state of that man is worse than the first."

entries.title: Luke 11:27
segments: It happened while he was saying this, that a certain woman out of the crowd shouted to him, saying, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breast that you have sucked."

entries.title: Luke 11:28
segments: "No, rather," he answered, "blessed are those who listen to the word of God, and keep it."

entries.title: Luke 11:29
segments: When the crowd were beginning to throng about him he proceeded to say: "This is an evil generation! It seeks a sign, and there shall be no sign be given to it except the sign of Jonah;

entries.title: Luke 11:30
segments: "for as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so shall the Son of man be to this generation.

entries.title: Luke 11:31
segments: "The queen of the South shall rise up in Judgement with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them; because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon, and lo, one greater than Solomon is here!

entries.title: Luke 11:32
segments: "The men of the Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with his generation and shall condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and lo! one greater than Jonah is here!

entries.title: Luke 11:33
segments: "When one lights a lamp he does not put it in a cellar nor under the bushel, but on a lamp-stand that those who enter may see the light.

entries.title: Luke 11:34
segments: "The lamp of the body is your eye; when your eye is single then your whole body is full of light; but when it is evil your whole body is full of darkness.

entries.title: Luke 11:35
segments: "Look carefully! Perhaps that very light of yours is darkness.

entries.title: Luke 11:36
segments: "If, however, your whole body is full of light, without having any part dark, it will be wholly radiant with light, as when the lamp illumines you with its bright rays."

entries.title: Luke 11:37
segments: When he had finished speaking a Pharisee asked him to dine with him; so he went in with him and reclined.

entries.title: Luke 11:38
segments: And the Pharisee noticed, to his amazement, that he did not wash his hands before eating,

entries.title: Luke 11:39
segments: but the Lord said to him: "You Pharisee do cleanse the outside of your cup or plate, but your secret heart is full of extortion and wickedness.

entries.title: Luke 11:40
segments: "Foolish men! Did not He who made the outside make the inside also?

entries.title: Luke 11:41
segments: "Better cleanse what is within, and nothing will be unclean for you.

entries.title: Luke 11:42
segments: "But woe unto you Pharisee! for you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and disregard justice and the love of God; but these you ought to have done, and not leave the other undone.

entries.title: Luke 11:43
segments: "Woe unto you Pharisee! for you delight in the best seats in the synagogue, and in the salutation in the market-places.

entries.title: Luke 11:44
segments: "Woe unto you! for you are like the tombs which are hidden, and men walk over them unsuspecting."

entries.title: Luke 11:45
segments: Hereupon one of the lawyers exclaimed, "But teacher, in saying such things you are also reproaching us also."

entries.title: Luke 11:46
segments: "Woe unto you lawyers also!" said Jesus, "for you load men with irksome burdens, and you yourselves will not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.

entries.title: Luke 11:47
segments: "Woe to you! for you are building the tombs of the prophets whom you ancestors killed.

entries.title: Luke 11:48
segments: "So you are witnesses, and you consent to the actions of your ancestors: for they killed them, and you build their tombs.

entries.title: Luke 11:49
segments: "For this reason also said the Wisdom of God: `I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and some they will persecute;

entries.title: Luke 11:50
segments: "so that the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required from this generation,

entries.title: Luke 11:51
segments: "from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the alter and the sanctuary; yes; I tell you, it shall be required of this generation!

entries.title: Luke 11:52
segments: "Woe to you lawyers, for you have taken away the key of knowledge!' You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who are trying to enter."

entries.title: Luke 11:53
segments: After he had gone away, the Scribes and the Pharisee began to set themselves vehemently against him, and to cross-question him upon many points,

entries.title: Luke 11:54
segments: laying in wait for him, in order to catch a word from his lips.
